intro: Return to the Magistrate concludes an urgent reconnaissance dispatch between the eastern border of Tirisfal Glades and the town of Brill. Having reported to Deathguard Linnea at her waystation east of Brill, adventurers are sent back to deliver troubling news directly to Magistrate Sevren. The message confirms that the mindless minions of the Lich King continue to test the borders of the young Forsaken nation.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you. He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.
And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.

clips.title: Completion
paras: It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark. The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.
But we will not give in. He will not take us again!

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
